about_the_game:
WarSpawn is a multiplayer action PvP game inspired by old-school PvP classics such as Rakion Online and Infinity Online. You play as a warspawn, a primordial being and soldier whose sole purpose is to fight for your Elder in the Cosmic Wars. So come slash, stab, grab, blast, and launch your way to victory using various weapons with no timegates or pay-to-win, just dive right into the action and have fun!

  • Dynamic hack-n-slash combat: Out-maneuver your opponents with well timed movement abilities. Engage them with light and heavy attack combo sets unique to each weapon. And finish them off with special ranged attacks as they attempt to flee. The tools at your disposal provides fast-paced dynamic gameplay with a combat system that aims to be easy to learn, difficult to master, and always fun.

  • Modern take on classic game modes: Enjoy kill-sprees in Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch. Then, inspired by Golem Wars (if you know, you know), hop into the teamwork focused Elder Wars mode where two teams fight to expose and then takedown the opposing Elder God in epic multiplayer boss-fight sequences.

  • Step into a world inspired by the works of H. P. Lovecraft and the artworks of Moebius: Our unique blend of Lovecraftian / Cosmic Horror, Moebius and Anime inspired aesthetics, and hardcore electronic soundscape creates a backdrop like none other for glorious PvP action.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later versions.
  • Processor: Intel or AMD Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 Feature Level AMD or NVIDIA Card with 1GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
